reference: M1 A.P.1590B II/III/V, applicable III supplement; H1 source fits. See the operating-4 research and method records.
scope: Merlin III teaching reconstruction: the crank drives twelve pistons through fork/plain rods, the 21/44 propeller reduction and indexed four-valve cam/rocker mechanism. Stroke, firing order, event windows and ratio follow the reviewed sources. Dimensions and casting contours include estimates; the 10 mm valve lift, smooth cam law and circular contact pads are illustrative. Spring annuli show compression envelopes, not wire or forces. Rear bevel internals, blower clutches, pump internals and pilot/pressure controls remain deferred and stationary. Playback shows one four-stroke cycle and stops: the 21/44 propeller ratio does not return the propeller to its starting angle after two crank turns. Reset deliberately returns to the reference pose. This is a kinematic teaching animation, not a validated manufacturing model or dynamics simulation.
